title: A careful first collaboration for STXBP1 and VAMP2 families

sentences.text: To VAMP2.org / Raging Raymond Foundation: we would welcome exploring a collaboration from the perspective of STXBP1 families.
STXBP1 and VAMP2 help assemble the same machinery for communication between nerve cells, called the SNARE complex.
The atlas also infers similar symptoms, but its confidence is 0.46, below 0.5; this is a starting point for questions, not proof that families’ experiences are alike.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: Could we start by exploring lessons from STARR (STXBP1 Clinical Trial Ready), rather than promising VAMP2 families access to the study?
We propose considering S-COMB outcome measures and the STXBP1 patient registry at University Hospital Heidelberg as further discussion topics, subject to permission and suitability checks.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Please help check whether impaired horizontal smooth pursuit, infantile encephalopathy and cerebral hypomyelination occur in VAMP2-related disorders, rather than treating gaps in recording as confirmed differences.
Could Scott Demarest review the plan, with confirmation of his work across SLC6A1- and STXBP1-related disorders?
Before offering STARR to VAMP2 families, let us confirm eligibility, permissions and which study elements would need adaptation.
We should also review the variant-function and chaperone questions below and check their relevance to this collaboration.
Mechanisms cannot be assumed identical: gain-of-function links are contested, and the VAMP2 ‘one working copy is not enough’ link is atlas-inferred, unverified and below 0.5 confidence.
Let us jointly send STARR’s team one short feasibility request asking whether and how its approach could be offered or adapted for VAMP2 families.
Which individual variants increase activity, impair catalytic activity or cause loss of function?
Which variants in GBA1, HEXA, NPC1 and GAA might be amenable to a protein-folding helper, or chaperone, using GLA variant classification as a comparison?
Dear VAMP2.org / Raging Raymond Foundation team,
We would welcome a small, careful collaboration.
Our communities have a biological connection through SNARE complex assembly.
Could we jointly ask STARR’s team about feasibility this month?
Let us clarify suitability before making any offer to families.
[Your name], on behalf of Asociación Síndrome STXBP1
